subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` threshold that lets operator automation ignore info-level secrets-audit findings?
rationale: The code is clean and default-compatible, but deciding whether a secrets-audit gate may intentionally pass with visible info findings is a security/product policy decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Hold until sponsored
options.body: Do not merge this PR unless a secrets/secops owner explicitly accepts the public audit-gate policy.

options.title: Sponsor current flag
options.body: Accept the opt-in CLI contract as written because plain `--check` still fails on any finding and the PR includes docs, tests, and terminal proof.

options.title: Request a narrower policy
options.body: Ask for a smaller owner-approved shape, such as limiting the threshold to specific finding classes or folding it into a broader audit/doctor design.

recommendation.title: Hold until sponsored
recommendation.body: Do not merge this PR unless a secrets/secops owner explicitly accepts the public audit-gate policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh has the strongest feature-history connection to the secrets audit flow and its CLI/docs contract, with secops review still needed for the policy boundary.
